newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica stocks off highs, De Beers tumbles.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica stocks off highs, De Beers tumbles.

text.p: South African shares finished off highs, failing to react positively to a better June producer price inflation and dragged lower by De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd's results which dealers described as "dissapointing."
Tax payable by De Beers and its international arm De Beers Centenary AG was $156 million in the interim period compared to $105 million in the same period last year.

Market watchers were dissapointed when stocks failed to react positively to a better-than expected producer price index figure. June PPI was up 7.5 percent year-on-year or down 0.2 percent month-on-month from 8.4 and 0.9 percent in May.
Gold shares finished flat on a dull bullion price.
The overall index ended off 3.2 points at 7,579.9 points, the industrial index finished up 28.3 points at 9,267.7 points and the gold index rose 0.8 points to 1,017.1.
